links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM predicted probabilities across repeated runs (intraclass correlation)
links.effect: Repeated predictions showed significant variability for both ChatGPT and DeepSeek.
links.quote: Repeated predictions showed significant variability for both models.

links.outcome: AUC of LLMs versus conventional logistic regression model on same data
links.effect: Zigong: ChatGPT AUC 0.59, DeepSeek 0.56 vs clinical model 0.63. MIMIC-IV: ChatGPT 0.72 vs clinical model 0.74 (P=0.31); DeepSeek 0.67.
links.quote: In the MIMIC-IV cohort, ChatGPT achieved higher discrimination (AUC 0.72) than DeepSeek (AUC 0.67, P < 0.001) and comparable performance to the clinical model (AUC 0.74, P = 0.31).

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark comparing the prognostic accuracy and reproducibility of LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) against conventional logistic regression models on two clinical datasets.
